d: At just 15, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has smashed a historic 204 off 53 balls, setting records and grabbing headlines. But what happens when a child becomes a superstar before growing up? From chess champion D Gukesh to football prodigy Freddy Adu, early success can bring enormous expectations and pressure. While talent can take young stars to the top, are they ready for the spotlight that comes with it? Palki Sharma looks at the challenges young prodigies face, what research tells us about supporting them, and why Vaibhav needs the freedom to grow beyond the game.
